scope: Actual learner React/DOM, browser IndexedDB/localStorage, and synthetic guest/config only. No real OAuth, classroom server search, provider, production, learning-effectiveness or installed-device verification.
limitations: Search covers only currently loaded personal workspace text, bounded saved study text, spaces, destinations and study tasks; server classes and other accounts are not indexed.
Goal choices are declared preferences, not measured ability. Closing setup without saving is not persisted as completion.
Manifest metadata is tested separately; this fixture does not prove browser/OS installation or offline capability.
